about: The 23 Nov 2026 rollout of main's migrations to the live database (project NexgApp). Read by scripts/check-migration-repeats.mjs and the live-rollout rehearsal in CI. See docs/database/live-rollout-2026-11-23.md.

revert.reason: Live ran activities_games_sports_enum here (branch codex/derrick-local-work-20261105). Main's own 20261111000000 (connector_outbox_claim_audit_exemption) never ran live; after this revert the push runs it. The enum value stays.
activities_games_sports_config: in no file on main. Its category_config row stays live.
Live ran host_unit_portfolio_save here; main has it as 20261113000100 (marked applied below). Main's own 20261111000200 (merchant_setup_storage_owner_grant) never ran; the push runs it.
Live ran host_manual_finance here; main has it as 20261113000200 (marked applied below). Main's own 20261111000300 (merchant_setup_write_audit) never ran; the push runs it.
host_workspace_preferences; main has it as 20261113000300 (marked applied below).
host_workspace_gallery; main has it as 20261113000400 (marked applied below).
scope_merchant_media_policy_check: in no file on main. authz.owns_merchant_offering_media and its two storage policies stay live.
host_workspace_cancel_placement; main has it as 20261113000600 (marked applied below).
retire_packages_with_valid_status; main has it as 20261113000700 (marked applied below).
host_scoped_privacy_status; main has it as 20261113000800 (marked applied below).
host_workspace_tasks; main has it as 20261113000900 (marked applied below).
host_workspace_guides; main has it as 20261113001000 (marked applied below).
unit_save_respects_unit_scope: in no file on main. rpc_unit_upsert_guarded is replaced by later main files (20261114000100, 20261223000700, 20270125000100, 20270220000100).
host_workspace_writes_are_audited: in no file on main. Both functions are replaced by 20261114000100.
gross_includes_vat: in no file on main. fn_fin_kpi_for keeps the VAT fix live; main never redefines it.
api_console_module: in no file on main. The console_module row 'api' stays live.
business_types_for_activities: reruns 20261106000000's idempotent update for the activities category; in no file on main.

payment_callbacks_and_audit_wiring: in no file on main. Its functions are dropped or replaced by later main files (20261112000300, 20261204000100, 20261206000100 and others); the rehearsal checks anon still cannot call a payment callback.

differences.why: Main's file gives p_version and p_patch defaults; live's copy has none. 20261114000100 re-creates the function with them, so nothing else is needed.
Main's file gives p_code a default of null; live's copy has none. 20270225000500_host_guide_asset_code_optional adds it.

sharedIds.reason: Three files used this id. Live ran activities_games_sports_enum (branch codex/derrick-local-work-20261105); merchant_application_hardening is open PR #59. The rollout reverts live's row and runs main's file.
Live ran host_unit_portfolio_save under this id (now 20261113000100 on main). The rollout reverts it and runs main's file.
Live ran host_manual_finance under this id (now 20261113000200 on main). The rollout reverts it and runs main's file.
